notes: SEC CIK 796343 resolved from the name.

Latest 10-K figure (31,360 as of 2025-11-28) is about 10.5 months old at the 2026-10-11 lookup. No fact sheet, integrated annual report or company-written LinkedIn/website headcount was found. The Semrush acquisition closed 2026-04-28 after the 10-K date and may add roughly 1,600 staff. Revelio's 33,044 (March 2026) is a modeled estimate on a different basis. LinkedIn member count (~42.5k) is far above filing figures; this gap is normal. A Blind-reported 500-person layoff in April 2026 is unconfirmed and excluded. Third-party pages (PitchBook, Wikipedia, market.us) restate the 10-K. FourWeekMBA and LeadIQ are not used: the former is stale trend data, the latter mirrors LinkedIn.
